name: app.formatika/mcp
description: Convert, compress, resize and trim images, audio, video and PDFs from local paths.

environmentVariables.name: FORMATIKA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access key from your formatika.app account. Without it the free daily allowance applies, which is enough for occasional work.

environmentVariables.name: FORMATIKA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the service. Only needed when pointing the server at a self-hosted instance.
